texts.orig: To summarize, the conclusion of current research is showing that consuming 3mg/kg caffeine, 1.5 g Lcarnitine and their combination has no meaningful effect on performance More researches are necessary in order to investigate the acute effects of different amount of  caffeine and L-carnitine on freestyle   performance time and the   blood lactate level.
